name: SNIP: Daily Word Cuts
subtitle: One cut. Two hidden words.
promotionalText: A little cut. A little clever. Find two hidden words with one snip, then share your spoiler-free receipt.
description:
A little cut. A little clever.

SNIP is a small daily word game with a satisfying twist. Cut one word out of another, and the letters left behind make a second word. Two clues. Two answers. One snip.

READ. SELECT. SNIP.
Follow the clues, drag across a continuous piece, and make your cut. You can also tap the first and last letter. Every letter has a place; no rearranging required.

YOUR DAILY THREE
Play the same dated edition as everyone else. Three puzzles make a short, thoughtful break. Daily editions change at midnight UTC, with a countdown in the app. This release includes a 30-day rotation of 90 daily puzzles.

A LITTLE MORE PLAY
Explore 12 extra puzzles in four practice collections, from First cuts to Fine cuts. Replay a collection whenever you fancy.

KEEP YOUR LITTLE RECEIPT
See your cuts, hints, and solves. Share a result card that keeps the answers secret. Track completed words, clean days, and your daily streak.

TAKE YOUR TIME
There are no timers or lives. Optional hints and reveals help you move along, and your receipt clearly records any help used.

MADE TO FEEL GOOD
Warm paper, expressive type, a crisp snip sound, and subtle haptics. Sound and haptics can be switched off. Includes larger text support, VoiceOver labels, and an alternative to dragging.

Everything works offline. Progress stays on your device. No accounts, advertisements, subscriptions, or in-app purchases. A daily reminder is available if you want one.

Made by HRLN interactive.
A small daily pleasure.
reviewNotes:
SNIP is a native, offline word puzzle game. No account, payment, or backend service is required.

On first launch, follow the three introduction pages to open First cuts. Select letters R through T in PIRATE, then tap Snip: RAT is removed and PIE remains. Continue with BEGGAR (remove EGG to leave BAR) and PATIENT (remove TIE to leave PANT). Drag selection and tapping endpoints are both supported.

The Today tab opens the daily set of three puzzles. Daily content is selected locally from a bundled 30-day cycle of 90 puzzles, using the UTC date. Practice contains four replayable three-puzzle collections. Hints are marked with an asterisk; reveals are shown as a dash and do not count as solves.

After finishing a set, Share your cuts opens the system share sheet with a spoiler-free image and text. Nothing is sent automatically. Settings includes optional local reminders, sound and haptics controls, privacy information, support email, and progress reset. Notification permission is requested only when the user enables reminders.

There is no advertising, tracking, third-party SDK, in-app purchase, or user-generated content. A privacy manifest declares app-local UserDefaults access. Artwork uses genuine simulator captures of First cuts, with no daily answers exposed.
